title: Winey Crisp Dutch Lamb Shoulder Tagine
description: A unique, flavorful lamb shoulder dish from the Netherlands, perfect for a solo dinner, halal-friendly and wine-pairable.
instructions: Cut the lamb shoulder into 1-inch pieces and season with salt, black pepper, and dried thyme.
Heat the olive oil in a Dutch oven over medium-high heat and brown the lamb pieces on all sides.
Remove the lamb from the pot and set aside. Add the sliced onion, minced garlic, chopped carrot, and sliced celery to the pot, cooking until the vegetables are tender.
Add the white wine to the pot, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom, then add the chicken broth and bring to a boil.
Return the lamb to the pot, cover, and transfer to the oven. Braise the lamb and vegetables for 2 hours at 300°F (150°C).
Remove the pot from the oven and stir in the chopped parsley. Serve the lamb and vegetables hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
